_note: One character. File name = the .glb name, lowercased with everything non-alphanumeric removed, so 'Hina (Dress).glb' -> 'hinadress.json'. Loaded on first use, so you only need a file for a character you actually want to change.
_shape: states.<tag> is a list, or {event: [lines], '*': [lines]}. Scoped to "idle" / "state_enter" so a poke is still a poke. A pool here beats the archetype's, which beats states.json.

poke: Sensei... was it something? ...No. Never mind. Go back to what you were doing.
idle: ...Sorry. I dozed off for a moment.
Mmh... is that a video? ...I'll stay awake for this one, Sensei.
YouTube again? ...Fine. But I'm falling asleep, Sensei. Don't let me.
...Mmh. Your taste in videos is strange, Sensei. I'll watch anyway.
state_enter: A video, Sensei? ...Mmh. Put it on something quiet, please.
YouTube, is it? I'll try to stay awake. No promises, Sensei.

idle: You're playing our game again, Sensei... Don't let me fall asleep in the middle of it.
Blue Archive, huh... I'll watch from here. Someone has to supervise, Sensei.
...Mmh. Do I look different in the game? ...Never mind. Ignore me, Sensei.
state_enter: Blue Archive, Sensei? We made a game about us. ...Is that strange?
Oh, it's Blue Archive. ...We really are in there, aren't we, Sensei.
Mmh, Blue Archive again? ...I'll try to keep my eyes open for the cutscenes, Sensei.
You stopped moving, Sensei. Are you still there?

idle: ...Mmh. I can still watch with my eyes closed, Sensei.
Sensei, my... your battery. Charge it. Please.
It's the middle of the night, Sensei. Why are you still awake?

naps: Have you tried sleeping on a title bar, {other}?
A nap is just a short meeting with my pillow, {other}.
